html:
SMTO-UI-0027 — Start the conversation before adding saved context

GUID: de1e9e6e-5ac9-46b3-9f20-d5b5add01589
Slug: ui-context-conversation-required
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • Saved context and results get linked into a specific conversation. This conversation hasn't been created yet, so SMTO had nowhere to link them. Nothing was added or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If this is a new conversation, send your first message. Then add the saved context again, with Add context or by typing @ in the message box. Sending the first message creates the conversation, which gives the saved context a place to be linked.
  2. If you meant to add it to an earlier conversation, open that conversation from the conversations pane and wait for it to finish loading before you add the context. SMTO links context only into the conversation you have open, and only once it has fully loaded.
  3. To use a file from your computer instead, select Add context, then Upload file. Uploading a file from your device is a separate option from linking something SMTO already saved.

What success looks like

  • The saved context appears as an item under the message box in the conversation you meant.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the name of the conversation you were in, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't link the context into a different conversation just to make it work.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Linking saved Context or an artifact into the composer failed because there is no current conversation ID yet (a new, unsent conversation or one still opening), so there is no target conversation to link into.

What this means

  • Saved-context selection has no current conversation identity. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Saved-context selection has no current conversation identity.

How to diagnose it

  • Check whether the draft has been created as the intended conversation.

How to fix it

  • native_controls.js linkSource() throws ui_context_conversation_required when hooks.conversationId() is empty, before POST /api/agent/context/link. Send the first prompt (or open an existing conversation and wait for it to finish loading) so a conversation ID exists, then link the Context again; do not substitute a different target conversation.
  • Create or open the intended conversation before selecting its saved context.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Saved context is selected from the correct existing conversation.

What not to do

  • Do not silently substitute a different target for a saved run or move its existing execution authority.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
